name: Out-of-Order Async Completion
essence: Two requests write one binding, and the one that finishes last wins.

examples.summary: beta is released first, then alpha overwrites the binding.
examples.mechanism: shown is a single let. Each completion assigns it with no generation check, so finish order, not request order, picks the value (CWE-362, CWE-696).
examples.expected_behavior: shown beta, the request that was meant to land last

ingredients.suggests: Each completion reassigns the same module-level shown binding.
Requests update the display after independently awaited completion without checking request order.

examples.summary: A shared mutable selection is replaced by whichever asynchronous load finishes last, even when it was requested first..
examples.mechanism: A shared mutable selection is replaced by whichever asynchronous load finishes last, even when it was requested first.

ingredients.suggests: Every completion reassigns the same module-level selection.
Independent awaited completions update the selection without checking request order.

examples.summary: The earlier request finishes last and overwrites the later display.
examples.mechanism: The earlier request finishes last and overwrites the later display.

ingredients.suggests: Each goroutine assigns after its own asynchronous readiness without checking request generation.

examples.summary: The earlier background request overwrites the later result.
examples.mechanism: Both completions reassign one mutable display binding. Background requests publish on completion without checking request order.
